# Kewti Complete LLM Reference (llms-full.txt)

> Comprehensive reference guide for AI coding assistants and developers integrating Kewti components.

---

## 1. Installation & Setup

Kewti follows a shadcn-like distribution model: source code is copied directly into your repository under `src/kewti/`, giving you complete ownership and styling flexibility with Tailwind CSS.

```bash
# Add components:
npx kewti-cli add calendar
npx kewti-cli add time
npx kewti-cli add input
npx kewti-cli add numerals
npx kewti-cli add location-selector
npx kewti-cli add select
npx kewti-cli add logo
npx kewti-cli add fonts

# Add fonts:
npx kewti-cli font Balderasu
npx kewti-cli font Bela_Bereka
npx kewti-cli font Loga_Comic
npx kewti-cli font Selam
```

---

## 2. Component Specifications

### 2.1 KewtiCalendar & KewtiDatePicker
Localized 13-month Ethiopian calendar view with month theme gradients, month artwork animations, national/religious holiday badges, and Gregorian toggle.

**Dependencies:** `kenat`, `framer-motion`, `lucide-react`

**Props:**
```typescript
interface CalendarProps {
  value?: Kenat;
  onChange?: (date: Kenat) => void;
  calendarPref?: "ethiopian" | "gregorian"; // default: "ethiopian"
  showAnimations?: boolean; // default: true
  showHolidays?: boolean; // default: true
  className?: string;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

interface DatePickerProps extends CalendarProps {
  placeholder?: string; // default: "ቀን ይምረጡ"
}
```

**Usage Example:**
```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { KewtiCalendar, KewtiDatePicker } from "@/kewti/ui";
import Kenat from "kenat";

export function CalendarDemo() {
  const [date, setDate] = useState<Kenat>(new Kenat());
  return (
    <div className="p-4 space-y-4">
      <KewtiDatePicker
        value={date}
        onChange={setDate}
        calendarPref="ethiopian"
      />
      <KewtiCalendar
        value={date}
        onChange={setDate}
        calendarPref="ethiopian"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

---

### 2.2 KewtiTime
Picker and converter for Ethiopian 12-hour offset solar time (`tewat`, `keseat`, `mishit`, `lelit`) and Standard time.

**Dependencies:** None

**Props & Types:**
```typescript
interface TimeValue {
  hour: number;   // 0 - 23 (24h standard value)
  minute: number; // 0 - 59
}

interface EthiopianTimePickerProps {
  value: TimeValue;
  onChange: (value: TimeValue) => void;
  mode?: "eth" | "std"; // default: "eth"
  className?: string;
  selectClassName?: string;
}
```

**Conversion Functions:**
```typescript
import { stdToEth, ethToStd24 } from "@/kewti/ui";

const { ethHour, period } = stdToEth(14); // 2:00 PM -> { ethHour: 8, period: "keseat" }
const stdHour = ethToStd24(8, "keseat");  // 14
```

**Usage Example:**
```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { KewtiTime } from "@/kewti/ui";

export function TimeDemo() {
  const [time, setTime] = useState({ hour: 8, minute: 30 }); // 8:30 AM = 2:30 ጠዋት
  return (
    <KewtiTime
      value={time}
      onChange={setTime}
      mode="eth"
    />
  );
}
```

---

### 2.3 KewtiInput & KewtiSpell
Phonetic Latin-to-Ge'ez transliteration, Amharic voice dictation (Web Speech API), Kebele ID / TIN format masking, and fuzzy spellchecking.

**Dependencies:** `lucide-react`, `fuse.js`

**Props:**
```typescript
interface KewtiInputProps extends React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement> {
  variant?: "input" | "textarea";
  value?: string;
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
  onSend?: (value: string) => void;
  defaultLanguage?: "am" | "en"; // default: "am"
  showVoiceInput?: boolean;
  spellCheck?: boolean;
}
```

**Usage Example:**
```tsx
"use client";
import { useState } from "react";
import { KewtiInput } from "@/kewti/ui";

export function InputDemo() {
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  return (
    <KewtiInput
      value={text}
      onValueChange={setText}
      placeholder="Type phonetically: selamu..."
      defaultLanguage="am"
      showVoiceInput={true}
      spellCheck={true}
    />
  );
}
```

---

### 2.4 KewtiNumerals
Converts standard Arabic numbers to Ge'ez numerals or spelled-out Amharic words (Birr & Santim).

**Dependencies:** `to-words`

**Functions & Props:**
```typescript
import { KewtiNumerals, toGeez, toAmharicWords } from "@/kewti/ui";

toGeez(2024); // "፳፻፳፬"
toAmharicWords(150.50, { currency: true }); // "አንድ መቶ ሃምሳ ብር ከ ሃምሳ ሳንቲም"
```

```tsx
<KewtiNumerals value={120} system="geez" />
<KewtiNumerals value={120} system="words" currency={true} />
```

---

### 2.5 KewtiLocationSelector
Hierarchical dropdown for Ethiopian administrative regions (Region / Admin 1 -> Zone / Subcity / Admin 2 -> Woreda / Admin 3).

**Dependencies:** `lucide-react`

**Usage Example:**
```tsx
"use client";
import { KewtiLocationSelector } from "@/kewti/ui";

export function LocationDemo() {
  return (
    <KewtiLocationSelector
      onLocationChange={(loc) => {
        console.log(loc.region, loc.zone, loc.woreda);
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

---

### 2.6 KewtiLogo
Vector brand icons for over 70 Ethiopian organizations, banks, tech companies, and universities.

```tsx
import { KewtiLogo } from "@/kewti/ui";

<KewtiLogo name="commercial_bank_of_ethiopia" className="h-10 w-auto" />
<KewtiLogo name="ethio_telecom" className="h-8 w-auto" />
<KewtiLogo name="ethiopian_airlines" className="h-8 w-auto" />
<KewtiLogo name="chapa" className="h-8 w-auto" />
```

---

### 2.7 Ethiopic Fonts & Pronunciation
- **Fonts:** `Balderasu`, `Bela_Bereka`, `Loga_Comic`, `Selam`
- Configure in Next.js using `next/font/local` pointing to `src/kewti/fonts/<Font>/...`
- Audio pronunciation: `<KewtiPronounce text="እንኳን ደህና መጡ">Click to Listen</KewtiPronounce>`
